description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, named IGeneratedEventReporterGrain. It specifies methods for reporting results, retrieving reports, resetting state, and checking silo location.

classes.name: IGeneratedEventReporterGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface for reporting and retrieving event data.

methods.name: ReportResult
methods.description: Reports a result tied to a specific stream identified by streamGuid, with provided provider, namespace, and count.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Retrieves a report for a specific stream provider and namespace, returning a dictionary mapping stream GUIDs to counts.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the grain.

methods.name: IsLocatedOnSilo
methods.description: Checks if the grain is located on the specified silo address.
